clock_alignment.assumption: deal time_msc and tick times are the same MT5 server-clock epoch; compared with no offset

quote_method.description: fill vs the last tick quote in a second strictly before the fill (tick times are 1 s resolution)

bar_method.description: fill vs the admitted M5 bid bar containing it; a buy carries the full spread against a bid bar, a sell none; spread and slip not separable
